import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { SKILL_TYPE_MAP } from '@src/constants';
import App from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/unequip/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 创建换下功法指令处理器
 * @param skillTypeName 技能类型名称（战技、被动技、神通）
 */
const createUnequipHandler = (skillTypeName: string) => {
  return onResponse(selects, async e => {
    const [message] = useMessage();
    const bid = e?.UserId;
    const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

    const uid = e.uid as number;

    // 调用数据层
    const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, skillTypeName, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

    switch (result.code) {
      case 'FAILED': {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, createBackendRequestContext(e));

        md.addText('❌ 换下失败');
        md.addNewline();
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(displayMsg);

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }

      case 'LOAD_FAILED': {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(result.data.message);

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }

      case 'OK': {
        const { result: unequipResult } = result.data;

        // 构建成功消息
        const successMessage = [
          '✅ 换下成功',
          '',
          `【${unequipResult.skillBook?.name}】`,
          `类型: ${unequipResult.skillBook?.skillType}`,
          '',
          '💡可通过 /我的功法 查看功法状态'
        ].join('\n');

        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(successMessage);

        md.addNewline();

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: '查看我的功法', command: '/我的功法' }] }));
      }
    }
  });
};

// 导出三种类型的换下处理器
export const unequipBattleSkill = createUnequipHandler(SKILL_TYPE_MAP['战技']);
export const unequipPassiveSkill = createUnequipHandler(SKILL_TYPE_MAP['被动技']);
export const unequipMysticSkill = createUnequipHandler(SKILL_TYPE_MAP['神通']);

// 默认导出战技换下处理器
export default unequipBattleSkill;
